post-install-output: * <fg=blue>api-forge</> generates services for REST APIs and their webhooks from documentation examples.
* Start the local web interface: <comment>php bin/console api-forge:serve</comment> (http://127.0.0.1:8765)
or follow the steps in the terminal: <comment>php bin/console api-forge:guide</comment>
* The settings are in <comment>config/packages/api_forge.yaml</comment>; secrets go in <comment>.env.local</comment>.
* To tweak a page of the interface, copy its template into <comment>templates/bundles/ApiForgeBundle/</comment>.
* To receive webhooks, install <comment>symfony/webhook</comment> (its recipe imports the /webhook/{type} route).
